title: bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1: half-range BSGS by Frobenius-6 inversion

claims.statement: For a nonidentity Q in G2 and a uniform z in GT, recover P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z under the pinned pairing convention. The deterministic half-range baby-step/giant-step procedure in proof.md succeeds with probability 1. Its total classical work is at most 2^130.704718 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents, including preprocessing, sorting, lookup, verification and output. Peak memory is at most 2^136.209454 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^129.161695 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in total work. Nonuniform advice is at most 2^0 bytes and is included in memory. No algorithm coins, restarts or uncharged advice are used. The exponential table is required by this procedure. This is an analytic generic bound, not a claim of a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Exhaust the half-range control flow on a small additive group, and check the public identities p^6 ≡ -1 (mod r) and w^{p^6} = -w in the pinned Fp12 monomial basis. This does not establish production memory or a timed attack.
